title: Customer Service Assistant
description: 45 Day Work Placement: Trainee Move Manager START YOUR CAREER IN MOVE MANAGEMENT No experience needed, full training provided. Are you a great communicator who enjoys helping people, staying organised and solving problems? If so, this could be the perfect opportunity for you. As a Trainee Move Manager, you will help customers throughout their moving journey and learn how international airfreight moves are coordinated from start to finish. WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING You will be part of an experienced team, learning how to support customers and coordinate small unaccompanied airfreight shipments around the world. With training and support, you will: - Supporting customers throughout their moving journey and providing clear, helpful updates. - Helping to coordinate small airfreight moves from collection through to delivery. - Working with DHL, internal teams and overseas agents to keep moves on track. - Tracking shipments and helping to solve problems or delays as they arise. - Keeping customer and shipment information accurate and up to date on company systems. - Learning how move costs and charges are recorded accurately. - Helping to collect customer feedback after each move. - Supporting move initiations and checking that the right information is in place. - Taking part in training, one-to-one coaching and mentoring to build your skills and confidence WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR No previous move management or removals experience is needed. We are looking for: - A positive and professional attitude. - Good written and verbal communication skills, with confidence speaking to customers and colleagues. - A genuine desire to help customers and solve problems. - Enthusiasm to learn professional move management and relocation skills. WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU? - Comprehensive training from experienced industry professionals. - One-to-one coaching and mentoring. - Practical experience in a fast-paced operational environment. - Exposure to relocation, removals, storage and Government Contracts operations. - The opportunity to build valuable workplace skills and confidence while being paid. - A professional reference at the end of the placement. - Onward career opportunities, subject to availability. Take your first leap into a professional Move Management career. No experience? No problem. Your career starts here.
